guidance: Name semantic predicates for business roles, not field storage. has_attribute is an abstract attribute base, never an authored edge predicate. Reuse or define a concrete business predicate; optional extends=has_attribute declares specialization. Generate every edge explicitly with properties.description. For semantic edges, explain the business relationship first; storage-only prose is insufficient. Grounding/catalog edges may explain physical roles. Add only material supported constraints and record/object/time scope; do not invent a disclaimer for every edge. Keep profiling counts, code lists, probe SQL, proof narratives and repeated endpoint definitions in metadata/evidence. A record key does not prove lifetime object identity. Category-level business links do not imply instance existence, universal participation, cardinality, non-null values, JOIN permission or reverse implication. A specific-object connection is not a universal claim about all objects. Missing verbatim wording, an unselected endpoint or an unobserved fact alone does not invalidate a reasonable business interpretation; verified bindings, defining calculations, Event admission and Rule requirements remain mandatory. Unqualified scope is the current database and active definition, not all history. Distinguish intrinsic knowledge from current request filters and preserve source disagreements. Attribute predicates connect the direct business bearer to its attribute-role Concept. Storage in an object's table does not establish ownership; relations do not transitively transfer attributes. Prefer the evidenced applicable subtype when an attribute belongs to that subtype, without inventing universal availability or exclusive ownership. is_a is same-kind class inclusion, not necessarily a strict or immediate subclass; no extra-knowledge admission test applies. Ordinary business assertions do not automatically move between classes and subclasses: is_a(C,B) and r(B,p) do not by themselves entail r(C,p), nor does the reverse. Such a move needs independent justification or an explicitly permitted rule. Shared parents imply neither sibling disjointness, overlap nor exhaustive coverage. category_of connects an attribute category/value meaning to its dimension, not the population satisfying it. An attribute slot and its value are not superclass/subclass. Keep endpoint meanings consistent, and never use description to contradict the predicate.
relation_metadata: Optional Concept groups: id, edges, description; at least two adjacent edges of the same predicate and direction. No implicit inference or expansion.
